# Cargo features

`Cargo.toml`'s `[features]` table has 14 entries. Feature activation is transitive (a feature's array can name another feature, which is then active too); the tables below compute that closure the way Cargo does, rather than asserting it. Regenerate with `uv run python tools/gen_feature_reference.py`; `--check` fails the build when this file is stale.
